definitions.explanation: A person one does not know or has never met. The classical negative form ぬ gives the expression a slightly literary quality.

examples.japanese: {見知|みし}らぬ{人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけられた。
{見知|みし}らぬ{人|ひと}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧いって⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけません→いける：06957_ikeru⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{見知|みし}らぬ{人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧にして⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: A stranger was kind to me on the train.

notes:
Uses the classical negative auxiliary ぬ (attached to the verb ⟦{見知|みし}る→見知る：14589_mishiru⟧, "to know by sight"), which is preserved as a fixed expression in modern Japanese. Sounds slightly more literary or formal than ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見知|みし}らぬ{人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけられる→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to be spoken to by a stranger
- ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ→見知る：14589_mishiru⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧: unfamiliar land
- ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ→見知る：14589_mishiru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: an unfamiliar face
- ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ→見知る：14589_mishiru⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: an unknown number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: someone you don't know — the everyday, conversational equivalent
- ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧: other person; stranger — emphasizes social distance or non-relation
- ⟦{赤|あか}の{他人|たにん}→赤の他人：07455_akanotanin⟧: a complete stranger — emphatic form stressing total lack of connection
